description.value: A longsword is a long-bladed sword that can be wielded with one or two hands. One-handed: 1d8 slashing. Two-handed: 1d12.
Chain mail consists of thousands of metal rings looped together into a mesh. AC bonus +4, Dex cap +1, check penalty -2, speed penalty -5 ft.
A minor healing potion restores 1d8 HP when drunk. An alchemist can make this with a DC 15 Crafting check.
A shortbow fires arrows from its draw and release mechanics. It can fire in the same space. Range 60 feet. 1d6 piercing.
A torch sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light to the next 20 feet. It burns for 1 hour.
A backpack holds up to 4 Bulk of items. It can be accessed as a free action.
An elixir of life restores 1d6 HP and grants a +1 bonus to saves against disease and poison for 10 minutes.
A climbing kit includes spikes, ropes, and other tools to assist with climbing. It grants +2 to Athletics checks to climb.
